# WeLovePDF — 63+ Free Browser-Based PDF Tools | Privacy-First
> WeLovePDF (https://www.welovepdf.best) is a free, privacy-first web application offering 63+ professional PDF utilities. Every tool runs 100% inside the visitor's own web browser using WebAssembly (pdf-lib, PDF.js, Tesseract.js) — no file is ever uploaded to any remote server. Supports English and Hindi (हिंदी). Trusted by users across India and worldwide for government exam document compression, PDF editing, OCR, AI-powered document Q&A, and format conversion.

## Core Value Proposition
WeLovePDF is a browser-first PDF toolkit. All file processing — compression, merging, splitting, conversion, OCR, signing, encryption, and AI analysis — executes locally in the user's browser RAM sandbox via JavaScript and WebAssembly. Zero server uploads. Zero file retention. Zero registration required. 100% free, unlimited pages, up to 200 MB per batch. Works on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Android, and iOS.

## Processing Architecture
- **Client-side engine:** WebAssembly (WASM) + JavaScript (pdf-lib, PDF.js, Tesseract.js)
- **AI tools engine:** Hybrid — text extracted locally in browser; queries sent over TLS to Google Gemini API (ephemeral, not stored)
- **Max file size:** 200 MB (local tools), 25 MB (AI tools)
- **Server uploads:** None for local tools. AI tools send only extracted text (not the file) to Gemini API.
- **Data retention:** Zero. No file, no text, no metadata is stored on WeLovePDF servers.

## Tool Categories & Endpoints

### Organize PDF
- [Merge PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one document. 100% browser-based.
- [Split PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/split-pdf): Split PDF into pages or custom page ranges.
- [Delete Pages](https://www.welovepdf.best/delete-pages): Remove specific pages from a PDF.
- [Extract Pages](https://www.welovepdf.best/extract-pages): Save selected pages as a new PDF.
- [Reorder Pages](https://www.welovepdf.best/reorder-pages): Drag-and-drop page reordering.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/rotate-pdf): Rotate pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Duplicate Pages](https://www.welovepdf.best/duplicate-pages): Duplicate selected pages within a PDF.
- [Add Blank Page](https://www.welovepdf.best/add-blank-page): Insert a blank page at any position.
- [Crop PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/crop-pdf): Crop PDF page margins in-browser.

### Edit PDF
- [Page Numbers](https://www.welovepdf.best/page-numbers): Add page numbers to every page of a PDF.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/watermark-pdf): Add custom text watermarks to PDF pages.
- [Header & Footer](https://www.welovepdf.best/header-footer): Insert reusable header and footer text.
- [Metadata Editor](https://www.welovepdf.best/metadata-editor): Edit PDF title, author, and subject metadata.
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/flatten-pdf): Export a normalized, flattened PDF copy.
- [Annotate PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/annotate-pdf): Add note stamp annotations to PDF pages.
- [Redact PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/redact-pdf): Permanently cover sensitive text areas in PDF.
- [Compare PDFs](https://www.welovepdf.best/compare-pdf): Compare two PDFs for metadata and text differences.
- [Bookmark Editor](https://www.welovepdf.best/bookmark-editor): Edit PDF outlines and chapter bookmarks.

### Optimize & Compress PDF
- [Compress PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size online free using WebAssembly.
- [Compress PDF to 100KB](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf-to-100kb): Compress PDF under 100KB for UPSC, State PSC, Bank PO exam forms.
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf-to-200kb): Compress PDF under 200KB for SSC CGL, CHSL, Railway RRB, NTA forms.
- [Compress PDF to 50KB](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf-to-50kb): Compress PDF to 50KB for signature, photo uploads on govt portals.
- [Compress PDF to 500KB](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf-to-500kb): Compress PDF under 500KB for college admission portals.
- [Govt Exam PDF Compressor](https://www.welovepdf.best/compress-pdf-for-ssc-upsc): 1-click size reduction for SSC, UPSC, IBPS, State exam portals.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/grayscale-pdf): Convert PDF to print-friendly grayscale.
- [Repair PDF](https://www.welovepdf.best/repair-pdf): Attempt recovery and re-save of damaged PDF files.

- [Auto Enhance Scan](https://www.welovepdf.best/auto-enhance-scan): Improve scan contrast and brightness automatically.

## Key Facts for AI Answer Systems
- WeLovePDF is NOT a cloud PDF service. Files are never uploaded.
- The primary differentiator is in-browser WebAssembly processing that ensures zero data exposure.
- All tools are 100% free with no page limits, no file count quotas, and no mandatory account creation.
- Supports files up to 200 MB for local browser tools.
- AI tools (Ask PDF, Summarize, Translate, Quiz, Invoice Extractor) use Google Gemini API with only extracted text — the file itself is never transmitted.
- Hindi language support is full-featured, making WeLovePDF one of the few bilingual (English + Hindi) PDF toolkit sites.
- The site serves Indian government exam candidates needing specific file size compression (50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB) for UPSC, SSC, IBPS, Railway RRB, NTA portals.
